_about: CAMREFRAME v102: approved V3 lock-cam reframe for far separations (CamReframe.cs, hooks in CameraRig). Fighters further apart than midpointFromSepM: look-at goes to their midpoint, the camera is pulled in toward maxDistM from the look-at as far as BOTH fighters stay in the CamFraming safe area (framing never relaxed), orbit tilted by pitchDeg (negative = lower; |pitchDeg| <= pitchLimitDeg). Finisher and death cameras untouched. enabled=false = today's pose. proof = the extra -camproof row.
